preheader: Oil prices jump 5% on tanker attacks, Goldman bets big on Asian tech, and Jannik Sinner ends his season.

lead.headline: Oil Prices Jump 5% After Tanker Attacks, Shaking Wall Street
lead.body: Oil prices surged as much as 5% on Thursday morning following Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The disruption to fuel traffic sent U.S. stocks lower and pushed Treasury yields up as investors worried about renewed inflation.
lead.why: Understanding how geopolitical shocks instantly impact energy prices and interest rates is key for your finance classes and personal investing decisions.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs Forecasts 26% Return for Asian Equities
stories.body: Goldman Sachs raised its outlook for Asian equities, projecting a 26% price return over the next 12 months. The investment bank expects this growth to be driven by a massive boom in technology corporate earnings.
stories.why: If you are looking to diversify your personal investment portfolio, keeping an eye on international tech markets could offer high-growth opportunities.

stories.headline: Small-Cap Stocks Struggle Under Rising Treasury Yields
stories.body: While large-cap stocks have held up relatively well, small-cap companies are suffering from higher interest rates. The Russell 2000 index has dropped more than 5% over the past month as Treasury yields soar.
stories.why: High interest rates disproportionately hurt smaller companies that rely on debt, which is a crucial factor to analyze when pitching stock valuations in your business classes.

stories.headline: Google Cloud Launches Persistent Gemini Agents for the Workplace
stories.body: Google unveiled its new Gemini agent, a universal assistant for enterprise customers that can research, write code, and coordinate other agents. These agents can run tasks for hours or days and get their own Gmail, Calendar, and Drive storage.
stories.why: As a future consultant, you will likely use these persistent agents to automate deep market research and document creation for clients.

stories.headline: Nintendo Switch 2 Key Card Sales Surge 631% in the U.S.
stories.body: Sales of physical game-key cards for the Nintendo Switch 2 have skyrocketed this year. This surge has helped drive a 5% year-over-year increase in overall physical video game spending in the U.S. so far in 2026.
stories.why: This massive growth shows how hybrid physical-digital retail models can completely revitalize legacy consumer sectors, a great case study for your marketing classes.

stories.headline: McKinsey Warns 11 Million U.S. Workers May Need to Switch Jobs by 2035
stories.body: A new McKinsey report estimates that 11 million American workers will need to transition to new occupations by 2035 due to automation. The report warns that six out of seven affected workers could face income loss during the transition.
stories.why: This massive labor shift will drive huge demand for management consultants who specialize in corporate restructuring and workforce retraining.

stories.headline: Deloitte Fined £6 Million Over Transport Audit Failures
stories.body: The UK's accounting watchdog fined Deloitte more than £6 million for its audits of transport firm Go-Ahead. The regulator cited a highly concerning pattern of failure over a five-year period.
stories.why: If you are targeting a career at a Big Four firm, understanding audit compliance failures and regulatory risks is essential for your business ethics courses.

stories.headline: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner Shuts Down 2026 Season Due to Injury
stories.body: Jannik Sinner has decided to end his historic 2026 season early because of an injury. The 24-year-old had enjoyed a dominant year, winning his first Wimbledon title and multiple Masters 1000 events, leaving a massive vacancy at the top of the ATP Tour.

term.name: Yield Curve
term.definition: A line that plots interest rates of bonds having equal credit quality but differing maturity dates. Today's news about surging Treasury yields and oil shocks directly impacts the yield curve, which investors watch closely to predict economic recessions or growth.

serve.headline: Manus raised over $500M after a blocked Meta acquisition
serve.body: The AI agent startup secured the massive funding round to rebuild its independent operations. This comes just weeks after Chinese regulators blocked Meta's proposed $2 billion acquisition of the company.
questions: How would you weigh the decision to accept a massive acquisition offer versus staying independent to build a long-term brand?
